title: R4-B0.1 pre-registration: A1 (M2 distance seeds + boundary-probability terrain) and C1/C2 (sub-pixel line width, China scale). Committed before any A1/C1/C2 run.

gate0_checks.prediction_files: 56/56 local prediction files match the manifest
gate0_checks.committed_files: 32/32 committed baseline files match the manifest

m2_hybrid_small_recall.source: R4-A2.2 eval JSON and R4-B0 Gate 2 recompute (identical)

gate0_checks.china_windows: the 12 windows of experiments/R4B0/preregistration.json gate4.windows, unchanged

change_policy: Each experiment runs once. After this commit only crash / implementation-bug fixes are allowed, documented in the gate report; no algorithm, parameter, threshold or window changes. A failed criterion is recorded as FAIL with its evidence and is not re-run.

a1.name: M2_DISTANCE_SEEDS_BOUNDARY_TERRAIN
a1.inputs: runs/r4a2/r4a22/<sheet>/M2/prob.npy (boundary_probability) and dist_px.npy (distance_prediction), float16 as saved; valid area = R4-A2.2 evaluation valid mask
a1.seeds: experiments/R4A/r4a2_1_seeds.hybrid_markers(distance_prediction), unchanged (same count, positions, filters as M2_hybrid)
a1.terrain: skimage watershed elevation = boundary_probability (float32); high probability = high elevation = barrier between basins. Direction verified on a synthetic map (unit test) before the run.
a1.topology: same as M2_hybrid: watershed labels over the whole image, evaluation inside the valid area, no extra merging or filtering
a1.baseline: M2_hybrid re-run from the same float16 files (R4-B0 Gate 2 method; recall identical to R4-A2.2), so the ONLY difference is the terrain
metrics: recall by own-mask width 3-6 / 6-10 / 10-20 px (and old width)
valid polygon fraction (shapely, exported with experiments/R4A/r4a2_2_export.py rules)
a1.success: on BOTH sheets: small recall(A1) - small recall(M2_hybrid) >= 0.02 AND small over-seg(A1) - small over-seg(M2_hybrid) <= 0.03

estimator.name: ink-mass sub-pixel line width
estimator.definition: see experiments/R4B0/r4b0_1_common.py docstring: w_j = sum(max(blackhat - local background, 0) within 1.5 px of component j) / (255 * orientation-corrected skeleton length L_j); estimate = length-weighted median over accepted line components
estimator.contrast_note: fixed full gray range, so w is a darkness-weighted width in px that scales linearly under area-averaging resampling; lighter ink reads as narrower (reported as a caveat in C2). Design history: an image-derived contrast (99th percentile of black-hat) was tried first on SYNTHETIC lines only and cancelled the scale signal; replaced before this commit. No GSJ or China image was used for any estimator choice.
estimator.local_background: median black-hat over the ring 1.5 < d <= 3.5 px
estimator.length: sum over skeleton pixels of 1 / max(|cos t|, |sin t|), t from the structure tensor (Gaussian 1 px mask smoothing, 2 px tensor smoothing)
estimator.text_and_pattern_exclusion: short components (< 40 px), non-elongated (L / w < 8), low mean orientation coherence (< 0.6: glyphs, curls, hatch blobs), many junctions (> 3 per 100 px: hatch / mesh patterns), wide footprint (area / L > 6 px: filled symbols, dense pattern areas)

validation.image: runs/r4a2/15023/geotiff_rgb.png (GSJ validation sheet; already used for C-type diagnostics in R4-B0)
validation.resampling: INTER_AREA for scale < 1, INTER_CUBIC for scale > 1, none for 1.0

pass_all.direction_bias: at every scale: 0.85 <= median(diagonal) / median(axial) <= 1.18 (diagonal = orientation >= 30 deg from the axes, axial <= 15 deg)
pass_all.text_contamination: at every scale: |median over components with L >= 60 px / overall median - 1| <= 0.15
pass_all.repeatability: two runs on the same image give identical results

validation.on_fail: SCALE_ESTIMATOR_FAILED; no second estimator; C2 not run

c2.gsj_reference: length-weighted median of accepted w_j pooled over the 10 frozen training sheets (geotiff_rgb.png)
c2.work_input: runs/real/<work>/work.png map box, as in R4-A2.2 / R4-B0 Gate 4
c2.work_reliable_if: enough_samples and spatially_consistent (>= 5 cells with >= 500 px accepted length, CV of cell medians <= 0.25)
c2.factor: f = w_gsj / w_work; NORMALISED iff reliable and 0.5 <= f <= 2.0; else SCALE_UNCERTAIN (original size, no clipping)
c2.resampling: INTER_AREA if f < 1, INTER_CUBIC if f > 1; no colour, saturation or contrast change
c2.inference: M1 and M2 best.pt unchanged, R4-A2.2 tiling and thresholds; one normalised run per NORMALISED work; outputs resized back (nearest) to the original size for comparison; original-size run kept as control
report: composition of p > 0.5: ink / colour edge without ink / other (R4-B0 Gate 4 definitions, unchanged)
u1: is the median probability still >= 0.2
new anomalies: change in region count, share p > 0.5 change > 2x either way
c2.no_accuracy: no reference labels: no precision / recall / F1; a higher on-ink share is NOT reported as higher accuracy

questions: A1 improves small recall without training?
keep M2 distance seeds + boundary terrain?
China anomaly mainly explained by scale?
next training still on narrow-unit interior supervision?

rules.A_success: A1 becomes a fixed R4-B1 post-processing candidate (development validation only)
rules.C_success_and_reduced: u1 median p < 0.2 and China on-ink share rises to >= 0.6 after normalisation -> study input-scale stability first
rules.C_pass_but_persists: prepare small China manual truth and cross-style data study
rules.C1_fail: scale question unresolved; no claim that China needs retraining

d.output: a minimal R4-B1 training proposal only; no training is started
